EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You've only got one more hider
to find, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Good luck!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Wait—forget I said that.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}I totally
forgot that you're not on my team!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Solo tienes que encontrar a
una persona más, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Buena suerte!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Espera, espera... No he dicho
nada.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0029:}} ¡Se me olvidaba que
no eras de mi equipo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Plus qu'un joueur à trouver,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bonne chance !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah... Zut !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}J'ai oublié qu'on était pas
dans le même camp !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Te ne manca solo uno da trovare,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} In bocca al lupo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Dimenticati quello che ti ho detto.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Che sbadato: non giochiamo
mica nella stessa squadra!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du musst nur noch eine Person
finden, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Viel Glück!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ups!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}Du bist ja gar nicht in meiner
Mannschaft!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bulman gereken yalnızca bir kişi
kaldı, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bol şans!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Dur—az
önce söylediğimi unut.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}Senin benim
takımımda olmadığını tamamen unutmuşum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh no!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} If you find one more person,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
we lose!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Oh, no!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Si encuentras a otra
persona más,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡perderemos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh, non !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu n'en as plus qu'un à
trouver et on perd !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh, no!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Se trovi un altro
giocatore,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} abbiamo perso!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh nein!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wenn du noch eine Person
findest, haben wir verloren!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Eyvah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bir kişi daha bulursan,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
biz kaybederiz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}There's still two of us left!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}We can totally still win this!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡Aún te quedan dos por encontrar!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Todavía podemos ganar!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ce ne sono ancora due da trovare!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se continuiamo così, vinceremo noi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Mich hast du gefunden, aber zwei
von uns sind noch übrig!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Du hast
noch lange nicht gewonnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Bizden hâlâ iki kişi kaldı!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu oyunu hâlâ kesinlikle kazanabiliriz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}The other two are really good at
hiding.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}I don't know if you'll be
able to find them!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}A los otros dos se les da pero que
muy bien esconderse.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡No sé
si conseguirás encontrarlos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Les deux autres sont vachement
forts pour se cacher.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Hé hé ! Tu vas
avoir du mal à les trouver !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ce ne sono ancora due che ti stanno
dando del filo da torcere.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Per loro
il nascondino non ha segreti! Auguri!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die anderen beiden sind echte
Verstecken-Profis.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}DIE findest
du nicht so leicht!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Diğer ikisi saklanmakta gerçekten
çok iyi.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0023:}}Onları bulabilecek misin,
hiç emin değilim!
